008package release.support;
009
010import java.io.BufferedReader;
011import java.io.IOException;
012import java.io.InputStreamReader;
013import java.util.Map;
014
015/**
016 * Utility to execute external system processes and capture their output.
017 */
018public final class ProcessRunner {
019    private ProcessRunner() {
020    }
021
022    /**
023     * Points the process at an installed JDK 21 or newer (via /usr/libexec/java_home), so the
024     * build does not depend on whichever Java happens to be the default.
025     */
026    public static void enforceJava21(ProcessBuilder pb) {
027        try {
028            Process proc = new ProcessBuilder("/usr/libexec/java_home", "-v", "21+").start();
029            try (BufferedReader reader = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(proc.getInputStream()))) {
030                String javaHome = reader.readLine();
031                proc.waitFor();
032                if (javaHome != null && !javaHome.isEmpty()) {
033                    Map<String, String> env = pb.environment();
034                    env.put("JAVA_HOME", javaHome);
035                    env.put("PATH", javaHome + "/bin:" + env.get("PATH"));
036                } else {
037                    System.err.println("⚠️  Java 21 or newer not found; Maven will use the default JDK.");
038                }
039            }
040        } catch (Exception e) {
041            System.err.println("⚠️  Could not select a Java 21 environment: " + e.getMessage());
042        }
043    }
044
045    public static Process startAndFilterOutput(ProcessBuilder pb, String moduleName) throws IOException {
046        pb.redirectErrorStream(true);
047        enforceJava21(pb);
048        Process process = pb.start();
049
050        try (BufferedReader reader = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(process.getInputStream()))) {
051            String line;
052            while ((line = reader.readLine()) != null) {
053                if (line.contains("sun.misc.Unsafe") || line.contains("HiddenClassDefiner")) {
054                    continue;
055                }
056                System.out.println("[" + moduleName + "] " + line);
057            }
058        }
059        return process;
060    }
061}
